description: An accumulator: the output climbs while one gate is open and falls while another is, at rates set separately, and holds its voltage when neither is

params.text: Sets how fast the output climbs, 0.01V per second at the bottom of its travel, 1V per second in the middle and 100V per second at the top
Climbs the output while it is held down, as a gate at the up jack does
Sends the output back to the bottom of its range while it is held down
Falls the output while it is held down, as a gate at the down jack does
Sets how fast the output falls, 0.01V per second at the bottom of its travel, 1V per second in the middle and 100V per second at the top
Chooses the span the output covers: 0V to 10V, or -5V to +5V

inputs.text: Above 0.5V the output climbs at the rate set by the up knob
Above 0.5V the output is sent back to the bottom of its range at once
Above 0.5V the output falls at the rate set by the down knob

outputs.text: The accumulated voltage, held between the two ends of the span the switch has chosen

notes: with both gates open at once the two rates fight and the output moves at the difference between them.
the output rests at the bottom of its range until a gate opens; nothing here runs on its own.
menu: Super-slow mode (rates ÷100) — divides both rate knobs by a hundred, so they run from 0.0001V per second to 1V per second with 0.01V per second in the middle
